promptSource.disposition: The geometry-generates-hierarchy slogan is useful; gravity leakage is an imprecise conflation and physical realization is unestablished.

exactStatements: AdS4 has connected isometry group SO0(2,3) and spin cover Spin0(2,3).
AdS5 has connected isometry group SO0(2,4) and spin cover Spin0(2,4).
The Karch-Randall background realizes an AdS4 brane inside AdS5.
The RS1 warp needed for a 10^16 mass hierarchy has kL approximately ln(10^16).
refusedInferences: The corpus Jordan real-form descent is the Karch-Randall brane.
A warped fifth dimension has been observed.
The spacelike fifth dimension is a second time or absolute frame.
Dark-disk models are consequences of warped geometry.
Spin(2,3) alone predicts the hierarchy, KK masses or radion couplings.
authorityBoundary: This register maps published model results to corpus questions. It neither asserts experimental realization of warped dimensions nor identifies equal symmetry groups acting on different carriers.
